ingredients: Chicken 500g, Yogurt 1 cup, Tomato puree 1 cup, Cream 1/2 cup, Onion 2, Ginger-garlic paste 2 tbsp, Garam masala 1 tsp, Chili powder 1 tsp, Turmeric 1/2 tsp, Oil 3 tbsp, Salt to taste
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 30 minutes. Grill or pan-fry until cooked. In a separate pan, saute onions and add ginger-garlic paste. Add tomato puree and spices. Add cooked chicken and cream. Simmer for 10 minutes.

ingredients: Red lentils 1 cup, Turmeric 1/2 tsp, Chili powder 1 tsp, Cumin seeds 1 tsp, Mustard seeds 1 tsp, Asafetida 1/4 tsp, Oil 3 tbsp, Garlic 3 cloves, Dried red chili 2, Salt to taste
instructions: Boil lentils with turmeric until soft. In a pan, heat oil and add mustard seeds, let them crackle. Add cumin seeds, garlic, and dried chili. Add asafetida. Pour this tempering over cooked lentils. Mix well and serve with rice.
